greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Kwanga ubabalo noxolo lukaThixo uBawo naye iNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu lungaba nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengemozulu—ngamanye amaxesha ilanga liyakhanya, kodwa ngamanye amaxesha amafu amnyama ayasondela, kwaye siyazi ukuba kukho iziphango ezizayo. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyithanda kakhulu indlela umhlaba osebenza ngayo. Wayengumfana onengqondo eqaqambileyo, umfana owayefunda iikhowudi ze-AI kwaye ecinga ngendlela yokulawula iinkqubo ezinkulu zeteknoloji. Kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, uBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukufunda 'iimpawu zexesha' ngendlela eyodwa. Wayengumfana owayesazi ukuba nini apho umzuzu ubalulekile, nini apho kufuneka uncume, kwaye nini apho kufuneka ubonise uthando olunzulu.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu ukhumbuza izihlwele ukuba zifunde ukutolika izinto ezizijikelezileyo. Uthi: 'Xa nibona ilifu lisenyuka entshonalanga, nithi kwangoko, liza kuna, kwaye kunjalo.' UYesu ubuza umbuzo onzima: 'Nani, kutheni ningakwazi ukutolika eli xesha langoku?' Eli xesha esikulo—eli xesha lokukhumbula uBen—lixesha elinzima, lixesha elineziphango zentliziyo, kodwa likwayixesha apho uThixo efuna ukusibonisa ukuba ukhona phakathi kwethu. UBen wayeyazi le nyaniso. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo enovelwano, umfana owayengaziboni nje izinto ezingaphandle, kodwa owayezibona iintliziyo zabantu abamngqongileyo.

Khumbula lo mfanekiso: uBen, eneminyaka elishumi nanhlanje, efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi. Kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango. UBen wayengumfana owayengalindi ukuba izinto zenzeke; wayeyindoda encinci eyayithatha inyathelo lothando.

KwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usicela ukuba 'siphile ngendlela efanele ubizo esilufumeneyo, ngobumnandi, nangobulali, nangonyamezelo, sithwalisana ngothando.' Le yindlela uBen aphila ngayo. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukunyamezela, eyayikwazi ukuthanda, kwaye eyayikwazi ukuba nomanyano nosapho lwayo. Xa ucinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale roller coaster enayikhwela ngeziganeko ezimnandi, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe.

Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

UYesu uthi kwiVangeli: 'Ukuba uya nomchasi wakho phambi kwegosa, zama ukulungisa umcimbi usendleleni.' Le yindlela yokuxolelana, yokuzolisa intliziyo, nokushiya imithwalo emdaka ngasemva. Nani, zama ukuzolisa iintliziyo zenu kule nyaniso: uBen ukhuselekile. Usemkhono kaThixo, apho akukho ntlungu, apho akukho zifo, apho kukho kuphela uthando olungenasiphelo. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. UBen usengumntwana ononcumo, usengumntwana ocinga ngekamva, usengumntwana okhathalayo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Mna, ndingumvalelwa ngenxa yeNkosi, ndiyanibongoza ukuba niphile ngendlela efanele ubizo enilufumeneyo, ngobumnandi, nangobulali, nangonyamezelo, sithwalisana ngothando, nizama ukugcina umanyano loMoya ngesibopho soxolo; umzimba mnye, noMoya mnye, njengoko nabizwa nani kwithemba elinye lobizo lwenu; iNkosi inye, ukholo lunye, ubhaptizo lunye; uThixo mnye, uYise wabo bonke, ophezu kwabo bonke, nophakathi kwabo bonke, nakubo bonke.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho. EzikaYehova ilizwe nokuzala kwalo, ihlabathi nabo bahlala kulo. Kuba yena waliseka phezu kweelwandle, walimisa phezu kwemilambo. R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho. Ngubani onokunyuka entabeni kaYehova? okanye ngubani onokuma kwindawo yakhe engcwele? Lowo unezandla ezingenatyala, nentliziyo ecocekileyo, onganqweneli izinto ezingento. R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho. Uya kwamkela intsikelelo evela kuYehova, nomvuzo evela kuThixo umsindisi wakhe. Isizwe esinjalo ngesifunayo, esifuna ubuso bukaThixo kaYakobi. R. Nkosi, esi sisizwe esilangazelela ukubona ubuso bakho.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kwizihlwele, 'Xa nibona ilifu lisenyuka entshonalanga, nithi kwangoko, liza kuna, kwaye kunjalo; kwaye xa nisiva umoya uvuthuza usuka ezantsi, nithi liza kuba shushu, kwaye kunjalo. Ziphatha-mhlaba nina! Niyakwazi ukutolika imbonakalo yomhlaba nesibhakabhaka; kutheni ningakwazi ukutolika eli xesha langoku? Kutheni ningagwebi nina ngokwenu okulungileyo? Ukuba uya nomchasi wakho phambi kwegosa, zama ukulungisa umcimbi usendleleni; kungenjalo umchasi wakho uya kukunikela kumgwebi, aze umgwebi akunikele kumchasi, aze umchasi akuphose entolongweni. Ndithi kuwe, awuyi kukhululwa ude uhlawule nepeni yokugqibela.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
